$comment: Machine-readable registry of retired, legacy-only and dormant items. Edit this file, then run `node scripts/docs/check-retired.mjs --write` to regenerate RETIRED.md and the README block. `npm run docs:check` fails if a `retired` item still has an active reference, if a retired component is listed in the active license table, or if a generated output is stale. Contract: docs/development/README_STRUCTURE.md.

statuses.retired: Removed. Zero active references allowed; history may still name it.
statuses.legacy-only pending removal: Still shipped for compatibility; no new work; replacement named; remaining references are counted, not gated.
statuses.dormant: Kept in the tree but not built, shipped or operated. Not retired.

historical.$comment: Paths whose text may name retired items: dated evidence, release history and the records of the removal itself.

items.item: Irancell font files (`irancell-*.ttf`) and their byte-identical copies `openfund-1.ttf`–`openfund-5.ttf`
items.note: "All rights reserved" with no recorded license; removed from public assets, `dist/`, `brand/typography/` and the investor pack, which resolved the provenance blocker.

items.item: Renamed Irancell derivatives "Openfund Persian" (`openfund-persian-*-v4.woff2`), Backstage `/persian.woff2`, certificate face `OpenfundCertificateFa`
items.note: Same unlicensed glyphs as Irancell under a new family name.

items.replacement: Dastkhat v1.210, which is based on Vazirmatn (SIL OFL 1.1) and credits it
items.note: Prose attribution "based on Vazirmatn" is required by the OFL and is not a reference to the retired copy.

items.item: Superseded platform releases v0.6.5 and v0.7.0 as the README's current release
items.replacement: The latest official release recorded in [docs/status/status.json](../status/status.json)
items.note: Runtime facts (for example a region still running v0.6.5) stay in the generated status block; release notes keep their history.

items.item: Dated README galleries ("Recent … captures — YYYY-MM-DD", "Full product gallery — recorded v0.6.5", the v0.4.4 capture set in `docs/assets/screenshots/readme/`)
items.replacement: One curated gallery generated from [docs/assets/gallery/gallery.json](../assets/gallery/gallery.json); the old sets are in [docs/reviews/_archive/readme-galleries/](../reviews/_archive/readme-galleries/README.md)
Kept as history under [docs/reviews/_archive/](../reviews/_archive/README.md); current state lives in [docs/status](../status/README.md)

items.item: Tracked `dist/` classic static snapshot (frozen classic site, asset mirror and script copies)
items.replacement: `apps/web-react/public/` (served assets and the legacy runtime), written by `npm run build:charts`
items.note: Never served by the backend; most files were byte-identical copies. Removed by owner decision together with its build-charts, upstream-guard and test references.

items.replacement: None — not retired; not built, shipped or operated ([provenance](../../packages/openfund-protocol/PROVENANCE.md))

items.item: Automatic free demo account (`demo_accounts.account_type = 'free_demo'`, 100,000 virtual USD created at sign-in)
items.replacement: Request-based 14-day Free Trial on the `free-trial` plan ([ADR 0062](../decisions/0062-request-based-free-trial.md)); existing rows are deleted by `npm --prefix apps/backend run retire-free-demo`
items.note: Sign-in no longer creates the account outside test mode. The engine keeps the account type as the fixture the backend and browser suites trade on (`SIM_TEST_MODE`); no product surface offers it.
